meta.title: Source Registry — Verified Document Set
meta.rule: No figure appears on the site unless it is traceable to an entry here. Every entry lists exactly what it was used to verify.

tiers.official-primary: Government/regulator/filer publication read directly at its own domain (e.g. federalreserve.gov, home.treasury.gov, sec.gov, bls.gov, edd.ca.gov, census.gov, dof.ca.gov, dir.ca.gov, leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, fire.ca.gov, irs.gov).
tiers.official-secondary: Figure published by a government body but read through a reproduction, or a government document quoting another agency. Acceptable only with the caveat recorded.
tiers.third-party: Not a government or filer source. NEVER counted as verified. Listed only so the user can see what was rejected.
tiers.unverified: Figure could not be confirmed at all. Appears on the Flagged for Review page with a blank value in the data tables.

meta.access_note: Direct curl/HTTP egress from the build sandbox to census.gov, bls.gov, fred.stlouisfed.org and api.bls.gov is blocked. All retrieval was performed through the agent's web retrieval layer. Where a series is available as machine-readable JSON (BLS Public API, Treasury, SEC EDGAR, leginfo), the raw endpoint is listed so the user can re-run it.

sources.publisher: California State Board of Equalization
sources.title: California Property Tax: An Overview (Publication 29)
verifies: Proposition 13 limits the property tax rate to 1% of assessed value plus incremental rates for locally voter-approved bonded indebtedness
Reappraisal at current fair market value occurs only on a change in ownership or completion of new construction (base year value)
Annual increases in the base year value generally limited to no more than 2% (or the change in California CPI if lower)
Proposition 8 permits a temporary decline-in-value assessment where market value falls below the factored base year value
Assessed value must be the lower of current market value or adjusted base year value

verifies: County may impose $0.55 per $500 (or fractional part) of consideration or value exceeding $100
